review_input.original_instruction: We're going to start in a room that has a very long brown table. If we look directly to the left of us we're going to see an open door. so we're going to walk towards that open door to be right in front of it. Then we'll see another open door directly in front of us. We're going to walk towards that open door until we're inside and it is a ladies bathroom. so we're going to walk inside the ladies bathroom. ON the left we'll see the sink and we'll see the bathroom stalls right in front of us. and we're going to go ahead and walk inside the opened bathroom stall. once we reached the opened bathroom stall we'll notice the small window right in front of us with the toilet to the left of us. And we will stop inside this bathroom stall

subtasks: We are starting in a room that has a very long brown table. Directly to the left is an open door. Walk towards that open door until you are right in front of it. Then walk towards the other open door directly in front of you until you are inside the ladies' bathroom.
